editorial.name: Going
editorial.descriptionZh: 机票特价会员服务 Going。帮你盯价格、发降价与 Mistake Fare 提醒，出票仍然自己到航司官网完成，会员分免费、Premium 与 Elite 三档。
editorial.takeawayZh: 订阅降价提醒，捡 Mistake Fare 自己出票
editorial.noteZh: 首屏米白底，左边挂一枚 Loved by 2M+, ★★★★★ rating 的绿色胶囊，下面是 Save up to 90% on flights 紫绿双色大标题与 Plan trips. Get alerts. Fly for less.，配紫色 Join for free 按钮；右边一部 iPhone 里显示一张雪山湖泊照片的通知卡 Your flight to Tokyo (HND) from JFK on Mar 28 - Apr 4 went down to $525 (was $1200+)，下半部散着 Today、The New York Times、Good Morning America、TRAVEL+ LEISURE、Kelly&Mark 的媒体标。导航是 HOW IT WORKS、CHEAP FLIGHTS、PREMIUM、ELITE、LOGIN、SIGN UP 全大写加一枚紫色 GET APP，正文按 Track prices、Get flight alerts、Book your flight anywhere you choose 三条讲清流程。

reasons.statement: Going 是 saaslandingpage.com 采集的机票特价会员服务首页；站内没有面向设计者的产出物，价值在首页的会员分层与提醒卡片排版，归产品官网。
